name: Smash and Grab

gist.Andras, the Human Weapon: When his attack hits one target and his Fighting is higher than the attack's level, it hits a second target as well.
gist.Sid, the King of Thieves: Before the game he looks through your deck, takes two different cards and may use them as if they cost no level at all.
gist.Heavy Hit: Attack that stuns; from Andras, two targets.
gist.Quick Attack: A free first attack each turn.
gist.Attack: A plain hit, doubled by Andras.
gist.Strong Ox Headbutt: You discard; better as a second attack.
gist.Ancient Tech Infinite Energy Core: More Attack for every different card in his discard pile.
gist.Sacred Hammer of the Volcano: More Attack, much more against burning targets.
gist.Phalanx Pike: More Attack; attacks do not spring traps.
gist.Escape: Reaction: discards a card to cancel a lethal attack or spell.
gist.Cloud Pillow: Halves damage to one target for a turn.
gist.Divine Gift of Coolness: Once: one hero becomes immune to all statuses.
gist.The Cosmic Depths: Area: once per turn a player may shuffle a hand card away to search out and summon a creature of a level they do not yet control (its effect is off for that turn).
gist.Arrival from the Cosmic Depths: Places a Cosmic Depths creature from his deck on YOUR side, then summons a bigger one for himself, all as a free action.
gist.Gatherer from the Cosmic Depths: Collects a Change Counter whenever its controller's opponent draws or searches by an effect; counters can be cashed in for cards.
gist.Life-Searcher from the Cosmic Depths: Arrives through Cosmic effects, searches another Cosmic card and can later swap itself for something from the deck.
gist.Analyzer from the Cosmic Depths: Collects a Change Counter whenever its controller's opponent draws or searches by an effect and spends them to drop Invader Tokens. While a token is out, a player who controls no card with Change Counters must discard a card or take a small hit at the end of each of their turns.
gist.Invader from the Cosmic Depths: A large creature that only Cosmic cards can summon; arrives with two Invader Tokens and discards spells for heavy hits.

plan: Brute force with one unconventional twist. Andras levels Fighting and every cheap attack hits two heroes; Quick Attack makes it four hits a turn. Sid meanwhile starts the game with the two best cards out of your own deck and plays them for free: against this deck that is usually Gathering Storm, attached to Sid on his first turn, and a Chain Lightning. There is no finesse and little defence beyond Escape. AS THE GUEST PLAYS IT: it is still this deck, and it is no longer played the way its owner played it. A handful of cards that were never in the list (The Cosmic Depths, Arrival, Analyzer, Gatherer, Life-Searcher) let it fetch the exact piece it is missing every turn, and the pilot holds resources back and keeps its answers for the right moment. The deck's strengths and weaknesses are unchanged; what has changed is that the mistakes are gone.

looks.early: Your own Gathering Storm on Sid on turn one. And an unfamiliar Area with a starfield on it.
looks.mid: Andras hitting two heroes twice a turn while your stolen Storm ticks on all three.
looks.late: Divine Gift of Coolness on Andras and a Heavy Hit on two targets.

opening.tell: Sid shows you two cards from your own deck before the first draw.
opening.why: A stolen Gathering Storm on Sid ticks on your three heroes every turn: The Yeeting removes an attachment cleanly, or Sid, who is small, must fall.

midgame.tell: Andras's cheap attacks each hit a second hero.
midgame.why: Two stuns a turn: Tea one back, freeze Andras for his turn, shield the hero that would fall. There is nothing to sweep.

crisis.tell: Andras has Fighting at three and wears the Energy Core.
crisis.why: Fire Bomb takes a Fighting off him: with lower Fighting his level-one attacks no longer double.

endgame.tell: Sid is gone and Andras is hurt.
endgame.why: Escape needs a discard he no longer has.

opening.board: Tobias's Sid opens by attaching YOUR Gathering Storm, taken from your deck.
Sid casts your Chain Lightning for free.

midgame.board: Heavy Hit stuns two of your heroes at once.
Quick Attack and Attack: four hits this turn.

options.text: Cloud in a Bottle on the weakest

midgame.board: Phalanx Pike: your Firewall stays face-down.

crisis.board: Fighting three and an Energy Core on Andras.
Divine Gift of Coolness: Andras cannot be frozen any more.
Strong Ox Headbutt empties your hand.

endgame.board: Escape cancels your finisher for his last card.
